_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
A si Mangu {player_id} e Three-Player Tic Tac Toe.
Alaaamaji maa e '{symbol}'.
A yahri e turne maa ina woodi alaaamaji maa e bortu 5x5 to form a line of four.
Lines yahri e horizontal, vertical, or diagonal.
Ina woodi e turne maa using the format '[4]' to mark cell 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Waylitol je wala bote. Naftir "[cell]" to cell woni 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Lewru jomii baa waawi: {cell}. Wataa e woodi e jowe gooto 0 e {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Jaawal {player_id} waɗi jaalowol je wala naffuda.

game_action.placed: Mangu {player_id} ina woodi alaaamaji ({symbol}) e jomii ({row}, {col}).
